title: Like Water for Chocolate
author: Laura Esquivel
summary: In revolution-era Mexico, Tita is forbidden to marry because she is the youngest daughter and must care for her mother. She pours her feelings into her cooking, and the food carries her emotions to those who eat it.
readIf: you like sensual, food-filled magical realism with a love story at its center.
skipIf: you want realistic fiction or a gentle, happy-feeling romance.
